summary.tldr: Creates a national day on October 22 to remember Canadian Armed Forces members who died in peacetime in Canada.
what_it_does: Designates October 22 each year as Peacetime Service and Sacrifice Memorial Day across Canada.
Requires the national flag of Canada on the Peace Tower to be lowered to half-mast on that day.
summary.background: The bill says its purpose is to encourage Canadians to remember and honour Canadian Armed Forces members who lost their lives on Canadian soil during peacetime.
